1: Aey Rasool ﷺ, beshak maine aap ko bay-shumaar bhalai di hai, jis mein se jannat mein Kausar ki nehar hai.
2: Pas is niyamat par Allah ka shukr ada kijiye, sirf usi ke liye namaz parh kar aur usi ke liye qurbani kar ke, us ke bar-khilaf jo mushrikeen apne buton ke liye qurbaniyan karte hain.
3: Beshak aap se nafrat karne wala har bhalai se kata hua hai, aur woh bhula diya jayega. Aur agar yaad kiya jayega, to bure tareeqe se yaad kiya jayega.
